content.short: FLOAT enables on-chain creation of events for web3 communities and proves attendance.
content.description: FLOAT enables on-chain creation of a wide range of events, including Discord AMAs, Twitter Spaces, educational certificates, giveaways, fundraisers, allowlists, merch vouchers, and quizzes. Across these formats, FLOAT automates attendee registration and attendance tracking, streamlining event management for communities and reducing manual overhead. The on-chain approach helps track participation and supports clearer records. For community managers seeking to boost engagement and scale with growing activity, FLOAT offers a practical, reliable option.
